title: The solid violet accent (#5B3FD0) is off every Frequency surface: buttons are the pastel pill with ink text, links and focus rings are ink

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-19 in the email thread: 'figure out where that purple color is coming from and get rid of it', 'I want it off the site. It's not the right accent.' Decision card answer: 'Pastel pill, ink links'.

detail: FILED 2026-10-19. WHERE THE PURPLE CAME FROM: the Frequency export's Commons theme (design_handoff/frequency/tokens/themes.css, mirrored in app/themes/frequency/core.css) binds --action-primary, --accent, --text-link and --focus-ring to --x-violet-deep #5B3FD0 with hover #4A31B8, and its dark theme to #A68BFF / #BBA6FF. app/themes/frequency.css bridges those to --color-primary, --color-primary-strong, --color-primary-bg and --design-map-pin, which 700+ components wear through bg-primary, text-primary-strong and bg-primary-bg. A 2026-10-15 override had already moved the action, link and focus roles to aqua presence on the app, so the violet that kept surfacing came from: --fq-accent (tags, stat icons, calendar picks, map pins, primarySoft buttons), 30 direct var(--fq-x-violet-deep) uses for editor selection rings, focus rings and card hover shadows, two hardcoded #5B3FD0 texts in the ig components, the website editor chrome (components/sites/editor/editor.css and canvas.tsx), and lib/theme/palette.ts, the static mirror that email, OG images, share cards, claim cards and the Wallet pass read (primary #5B3FD0, emailPrimaryStrong #4A31B8, ogAccent #8B5CFF). THE SWAP: Commons action, accent, link and focus roles bind to the ink #1E1B18 (dark: the bone #FBF2E6); the per-room override binds them to --fq-text-strong so Stage, night and skins get their own ink; the site kit .btn and the site-blocks CTA draw the --fq-pa pastel pill with ink text; editor rings and selection use --fq-focus-ring; hover shadows tint from --fq-ink; palette.ts primary and emailPrimaryStrong are ink, onPrimary the canvas, primaryBg the sunken sand, ogAccent the --fq-pa sky stop #A3D4FF. KEPT: the --fq-pa pastel stops (#C4B8FF lilac is one of its four stops, by the owner's choice), --fq-x-violet-neon in the Stage aura, wing and mood washes (blurred atmospherics, not a solid accent), the [data-tone=violet] entity tone, and the Stage theme's UV palette. design_handoff/frequency/ untouched. The member Button primitive already drew the pa pill under Frequency (ADR-1740), so member buttons do not change. ADR-1791.
